summary.text: Justin Gillespie is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 47, where he faces Republican incumbent Frank Ginn in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign listed living wages and fair tax policies, affordable health care with expanded rural access, and labor standards and workplace safety as its main messages.

paragraphs.text: Gillespie was the only candidate on the Democratic primary ballot for District 47 on May 19, 2026, and received 14,693 votes.

In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign described a platform built on inclusivity, financial stability for families and expanded access to quality health care, and said he would fight for protections and resources for local farmers.
Gillespie said in the survey that the policy areas he cares most about are local agriculture, public education and tax policy that makes life more affordable for families.
